bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:8036e159-af0b-.description: Design, implement, and maintain Bumble application features that are scalable, secure, and reliable, using GCP services. Drive technically complex individual product features from inception to delivery, owning the full software development lifecycle. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to ship new features and improvements. Evaluate and apply AI-based development tools and workflows to enhance productivity and code quality. Lead architecture discussions and propose technical solutions that support long-term scalability. Support junior engineers through pairing, mentoring, and code reviews. Guide the development of engineering standards and best practices to maintain a high-quality codebase. 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production Android applications Strong proficiency in Kotlin and experience with modern Android development practices Experience building UIs using Jetpack Compose and/or XML-based views, with an understanding of their tradeoffs Proven experience designing and maintaining Android application architectures (e.g. MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture) in medium-to-large codebases Solid understanding of Android platform fundamentals, including activity/fragment lifecycle, threading, performance, and memory management Experience integrating and consuming networked APIs from Android clients, including error handling and offline considerations Experience owning Android features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through testing and release Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, inclusive mindset Own meaningful projects that directly impact millions of Bumble users. Learn and grow in a high-performing engineering team committed to mentorship and learning. Be part of a culture that values respect, excellence, curiosity, courage and joy. Enjoy competitive compensation, equity, and world-class benefits. This role is based in Austin, and we ask that you’re within a commutable distance to this office, so that you’re able to come onsite regularly to collaborate across engineering teams. We have a hybrid environment that requires you to be in the office Monday - Wednesday. Please note: We are unable to offer Visa sponsorship at this time About Us Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. AI Fluency AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes. We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us. Final Compensation Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations. Benefits & Perks Insurance: Medical/dental/vision, 30-day eligibility. Bumble has multiple competitive offerings that will be available to you on the first of the month following date of hire. councilcapital-council-capital:ashbyhq:9.title: Director of Marketing -  B2B
councilcapital-council-capital:ashbyhq:9.description: Council Capital is a healthcare-focused private equity firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, managing over $350 million in committed capital. We invest in lower middle market healthcare companies where we see the potential to scale purpose and performance. Our investments span control and minority positions in businesses with enterprise values between $10 million and $100 million. What sets us apart is the Council Model—a proven framework that surrounds founders and leadership teams with a powerful combination of support: our CEO Council of seasoned operators, our Strategic Healthcare Investors who bring real-world insight and access, and our internal Value Creation Team, focused on enabling growth through talent, systems, and strategy. At Council Capital, we’re not just backing companies—we’re helping build enduring businesses that improve lives and shape the future of healthcare. About the Company This is a private equity-backed healthcare technology company operating in the payment-integrity space. The AI-driven analytics platform helps commercial and government payers detect and prevent fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA), delivering measurable financial outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. The company is scaling quickly and investing in marketing as a growth engine. This role exists to bring discipline, consistency, and compelling storytelling to how the company goes to market, turning a sophisticated platform into a clear, differentiated brand. The Role The company seeks a hands-on marketing leader who can both set the table and do the work. You will own the execution of marketing across brand, messaging, digital, and events, translating a complex analytics platform into clear, compelling value propositions for distinct healthcare buyers. This is an individual-contributor role reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, who owns the marketing vision and budget. You bring the craft, the discipline, and the follow-through. The biggest wins in year one come from unifying the brand, holding consistent external messaging, and getting real leverage from digital channels and marketing tools. You will have genuine autonomy over how the work gets done and how the brand shows up in the market. Strong candidates are excited to build and execute, not to manage a large team. You are encouraged to bring innovative approaches to outbound messaging and targeting. What You Will Do - Own and unify brand and positioning. Bring consistency to templates, decks, email signatures, and collateral, ensuring a single, professional external brand. - Enforce message discipline. Maintain consistent, on-strategy external messaging across commercial-payer, government/Medicaid, and Medicare audiences. No drift, no ad hoc jargon. - Translate capabilities into buyer value. Turn complex payment-integrity and FWA capabilities into clear, differentiated value propositions by buyer persona. - Run digital marketing end to end. Improve website user experience and conversion, get maximum value from the marketing-automation stack (e.g., HubSpot), and grow qualified traffic through SEO/AEO, against measurable targets. - Build sales-enablement narratives. Deliver market-ready messaging frameworks and sales collateral at roughly 70 to 80% finished, so product and sales refine only the last mile (today that ratio is inverted). - Design and execute buyer-persona campaigns. Distinct programs for commercial, government, and Medicare/Medicaid buyers. - Own events end to end. Plan and run roughly 6 to 10 events per year (about 2 requiring travel): booth, collateral, pre-event demand, and post-event follow-up, and manage outside vendors and sponsorships. - Manage to a budget you help optimize. Deliver maximum value from marketing spend set by the Chief Growth Officer, with disciplined stewardship rather than P&L ownership. - Report on what is working. Define and track marketing KPIs (traffic, conversion, and pipeline contribution), and share results and learnings with leadership.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:77552ddf-a585-.title: AI Presales & Delivery Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:77552ddf-a585-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Presales & Delivery Lead based in the United States. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity focused on scaling AI solutions across North American and international markets. You will combine technical expertise, customer-facing leadership, and commercial acumen to drive AI opportunities from discovery through delivery. The role sits at the intersection of sales, solution architecture, delivery, and client success, with ownership across the AI portfolio and its P&L performance. You will shape AI and product-build engagements, translate business challenges into compelling technical solutions, and demonstrate measurable business value. The position also provides significant influence over delivery processes, profitability, conversion rates, and cross-business growth opportunities. You will collaborate with sales leaders, client partners, project managers, architects, data engineers, and product specialists across distributed teams. This is an ideal role for an experienced AI professional who enjoys fast-paced environments, complex customer challenges, and building scalable solutions. AI presales leadership: Serve as the primary presales subject-matter expert for AI and product-build engagements, guiding prospect conversations, discovery, solutioning, and opportunity development. Discovery and solution design: Lead customer discovery and scoping sessions, translate business challenges into technical solutions, develop cost models, and align estimates with delivery and P&L leadership. Proposals and commercial development: Develop Statements of Work, proposals, estimates, and related commercial materials while maintaining appropriate margin and delivery discipline. Technical coordination: Prepare and coordinate technical specialists, including AI and software architects, data engineers, and product leaders, for customer-facing engagements. Delivery leadership: Lead project kickoffs and serve as delivery lead for AI assessments, proofs of concept, and product-oriented engagements, ensuring clear objectives, scope, success criteria, and high-quality deliverables. Project execution: Oversee AI engagements from inception through delivery, monitoring timelines, budgets, quality, risks, dependencies, and customer expectations. Client partnership: Build trusted relationships with customers and sales stakeholders, communicate business value and ROI effectively, and proactively resolve delivery challenges. Delivery excellence: Promote consistent delivery practices, strong communication, solution-oriented problem solving, and a high-quality client experience across AI engagements. Portfolio growth: Identify opportunities to improve presales conversion, accelerate PoC-to-implementation timelines, increase profitability, and create cross-business opportunities. Performance management: Contribute to measurable growth in AI revenue, project conversion, cross-business engagement, and customer satisfaction across the assigned market. Requirements Professional experience: 5+ years of experience in AI/ML solutioning or product development, ideally combining professional-services delivery and presales responsibilities. Presales expertise: At least 2 years of customer-facing presales experience with North American clients, including solution design, discovery, commercial discussions, and proposal development. AI commercial experience: At least 1 year of experience developing LOEs and Statements of Work for AI proofs of concept; AWS experience is highly preferred. Delivery background: Demonstrated success managing customer-facing AI or software engagements from initial concept through implementation. Project management: Experience managing 10+ concurrent projects and/or sales pursuits while maintaining strong prioritization and execution discipline. Technical foundation: Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:8cd64fd4-4.description: About Your Team Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought-after e-commerce destinations. About The Role We are looking for a highly driven and technically strong HR professional to join our team as an Assistant Manager – HR, with a core focus on HR systems, analytics, AI-driven solutions, and automation. This role is not about managing processes at the surface level, it is about deep problem discovery, building scalable solutions, and continuously improving the employee experience through technology. The ideal candidate is someone who is curious, hands-on, and user-first, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems and solve them using data, systems, and emerging technologies like AI.
